methods.notes: Exact-prefix advertisement and app-filter evidence. Do not add FFF0 here: it would reactivate unrelated FFF0 specs. Advertising can be intermittent, so rediscover freshly and do not persist a stale address.

identification.notes: LOYPRO 2.1.04 explicitly accepts this prefix. The reviewed LOY PLAY and LOY SPACE versions accept only YS/TL. Digits after LOY have no proven model or resolution meaning; use the information reply for identity.

device.name: LOY / LOYPRO Helmet and B3 Tail-Light LED Display
device.notes:
LOY/YSKJ AA55 binary-TLV display family. The captured product is a B3 motorcycle tail light supplied with bicycle and helmet mounts; its firmware identity contains MTYB3BGR. The earlier physical description as a helmet- worn display and the B3 listing are complementary, not evidence that every LOY-named product has the same shell or trigger inputs.
GEOMETRY IS NOT ONE NUMBER: the device-information/TLV canvas is 48x16, while the captured animated GIF is 48x15. Query geometry and preserve the source media's dimensions; do not pad a 48x15 GIF header into a 48x16 TLV canvas or infer that firmware and physical dimensions must be identical.
FFF0 is retained in services for post-connect use, never as an independent identification signal. Unrelated panels, thermometers, battery monitors, OBD adapters and treadmills use it. AUTOBABA is a protocol relative but its reviewed filter expects YS/TL. The Shining Display/TR helmet platform uses FA02 and is a different protocol documented by led-helmet-display.yaml.
UPLOAD SAFETY: 08 02 00 00 is a delete/replace-first-program TLV inside an ordinary program header. It is NOT an upload-ready probe. The earlier delete-only READY attempt was therefore destructive in intent even though it timed out. Choose a program slot deliberately, send the complete program sequence, and wait for each matching ACK before continuing.
VEHICLE INPUTS: remote, car_linkage, brake and power are confirmed firmware capabilities. The upgraded image also contains an MSA311 sensor driver, but neither the driver string nor those tokens establishes an integrated accelerometer, wiring, a particular remote or a motion-to-animation map. Short type-6 tag-0x36 notifications decode as playback model/index data, not accelerometer axes.

openness.notes: LOYPRO explicitly accepts advertised names beginning LOY, unlike the reviewed LOY PLAY and LOY SPACE app versions that accept only YS and TL. That prefix, not the widely shared 0xFFF0 service, is the scan-time discriminator. Protocol facts come from a live information query and an official-app capture, not from copying vendor implementation code.

pairing.notes: The information query and official-app control capture required no bond. Optional application password support exists; no configured password was observed and no bypass is documented.

credentials.notes: No account, Wi-Fi credential or pairing secret is established. The device reports pwd support, but whether one is configured is unknown; use the owner's normal flow rather than guessing or bypassing it.

factory_reset.effect: No reset is established. Do not use delete-program, playback or firmware operations as pairing, reset or identification probes.

methods.description: Match LOY, confirm FFF2 write-without-response and FFF1 notify, subscribe, then send the AA55 information query with response=False. The observed unit returned a checksum-valid response without pairing.
methods.name: LOYPRO information query and identification

steps.action: Scan for a fresh LOY-prefixed advertisement and connect without persisting a stale address.
Enumerate GATT and confirm FFF2 is write-without-response and FFF1 is notify.
Subscribe to FFF1 and request device/panel information using protocol_details.read_only_identification.
steps.expect: A checksum-valid AA55 reply identifying firmware, capabilities and little-endian width/height; stop if the dialect differs.

setup.notes: No account or provisioning is required for the confirmed BLE path. Start read-only: enumerate GATT, subscribe to FFF1 and issue dev_info_all. Uploads replace stored programs and firmware updates are advanced operations, not onboarding steps.

rejoin.notes: Rediscover by the advertised name and confirmed characteristics. The address may be stale and advertising may pause with power state or another central. Stored programs persist across the captured upgrade.

testing.notes: On 2026-11-08 this project used the documented dev_info_all query on the LOY-named unit and confirmed FFF2/FFF1, little-endian 48x16 geometry and firmware V2.9.1#V18. A supplied official-app capture later that day was decoded and replayed offline by this project: all AA55 lengths/checksums, 84 type-2 ACKs, 377 type-4 ACKs, custom YSTP01 images/text, static and 65-frame GIF resources, playback and a V18-to-V24 firmware update. The offline builder reproduces the captured 48x15 GIF upload's eight packets byte-for-byte. No new display, configuration, reset or firmware write was made by this project during capture analysis.

entities.name: Stored Program Playback
entities.notes: Playback uses tag 0x36 with model, index and an explicit program-ID list. No generic command is declared because selecting/replacing programs needs the dedicated popled_json handler and a deliberate stored-slot choice.

artifacts.description: Fresh name-based discovery, complete GATT enumeration and one query; confirmed FFF2/FFF1 properties, a checksum-valid 159-byte reply, 48x16 geometry, brightness 15 and the capabilities recorded above. No display, configuration, pairing, reset or firmware write was performed.

artifacts.artifact: Official LOY app B3 control capture, 2026-11-08
artifacts.description: 7086-packet pcapng containing information, custom YSTP01 images/text, static and animated GIFs, playback, and a V18-to-V24 type-4 upgrade. This project's decoder validated 969 reassembled AA55 checksums, 84 ordinary ACKs and 377 upgrade ACKs; no new hardware write was made.

Reproduces all eight packets of the captured 48x15 GIF program upload byte-for-byte and verifies the firmware image's sum16 and MD5. Generated examples in this spec contain no user media or unit identifiers.

artifacts.artifact: LOYPRO com.yskj.loypro 2.1.04 and LOY PLAY com.yskj.loy 1.7.15
artifacts.description: Established the LOY versus YS/TL scan-filter distinction and corroborated the GATT map, resource-ID algorithm, playback and vehicle-linkage paths.
Independent LOY PLAY / YSKJ client with the same service map and AA55 framing; tested another named device, not this B3 unit.

features.notes: Official capture proves raw GIF and YSTP01 program media, including a 48x15 65-frame GIF on a 48x16 TLV canvas. The offline builder reproduces all eight packets of the captured upload. This is capture confirmation, not a new third-party hardware write or visible-rendering claim.

AA55 program/region/item TLVs contain GIF or YSTP01 media. Programs are stored under zero-based IDs and selected by tag-0x36 playback lists after disconnect. The program header replaces the chosen slot; it is not a harmless READY operation.

dfu_mode.notes: No DFU name/address or alternate GATT layout was recorded; post-update queries returned V2.9.1#V24.

enter.notes: The running connection accepts type-4 chunks, then disconnects/reconnects; no separate bootloader identity is documented.

image.format: Type-4 resource-upgrade stream with text metadata, sum16 and MD5 integrity values
image.notes: The captured V24 image is evidence only, not a reusable update package for other units.

dfu.notes: Capture-confirmed but deliberately not exposed as a generic command. Use exact-model images, per-chunk 0x84 ACKs and post-update version readback. Wrong-image and interrupted-update behavior are unknown.

initialization.notes: Open replies before information, upload, playback or firmware operations; reassemble ATT fragments before parsing AA55.

covers: Device information, geometry, firmware and capability discovery
Stored custom YSTP01 image/text pages, raw static or animated GIF programs
Ascending 960-byte media chunks with per-packet ACK and resource finalization
Type-4 firmware resource upgrade with integrity metadata and post-update version readback
not_covered: Vehicle-input bindings, trigger mappings, sensor scaling and live brake events
Factory reset, password configuration and arbitrary firmware/media compatibility
local_access.summary: Information, stored program upload, GIF/YSTP media, playback and the captured type-4 resource upgrade all operate locally over FFF2/FFF1. Uploads and firmware require dedicated AA55/TLV handling and ACKs; they are not generic one-write commands.

aa55_framing.att_rule: Join ATT values to the declared AA55 length before length/checksum validation or ACK matching.

checksum.algorithm: sum of every preceding byte including AA 55 FF FF, modulo 65536

length.covers: sequence + flags + command_type + payload + checksum; physical packet bytes = declared length + 6

ordinary_ack.matching_rule: Require flags 0x81, response type 0x82, the request sequence and status zero before sending the next type-2 packet.
ordinary_ack.payload_encoding: One raw status byte, not a TLV

status.nonzero: Reject/failure; no captured nonzero values or vendor error taxonomy

ordinary_ack.synthetic_note: The nonzero vector only tests rejection handling; 0x01 is constructed, not an observed or named device error.

payload.encoding: Binary TLV for host program/control/query packets; ordinary and upgrade ACKs instead carry one raw status byte as declared below

sequence.note: May be reused by later operations; correlate within the current connection/operation.

upgrade_ack.matching_rule: Require flags 0x81, response type 0x84, the request sequence and status zero before sending the next type-4 chunk.
upgrade_ack.payload_encoding: One raw status byte, not a TLV

status.nonzero: Reject/failure; no captured nonzero values or vendor error taxonomy

upgrade_ack.synthetic_note: The nonzero vector only tests rejection handling; 0x01 is constructed, not an observed or named device error.

family_evidence.confirmed_product: B3 motorcycle tail light / helmet-mount display, firmware family MTYB3BGR
family_evidence.transport_shape: AA55 framing, little-endian sequence/length/checksum, flags/type and binary TLVs

firmware_upgrade.acknowledgement_rule: After every type-4 chunk, require flags 0x81, type 0x84, matching sequence and raw status zero at offset 10 before continuing

integrity.md5: MD5 of the reconstructed image matches the digest in the resource ID
integrity.sum16: 16-bit additive value stated in the metadata
integrity.warning: MD5 and sum16 are integrity checks, not a vendor signature or evidence that an image is safe for another device.

firmware_upgrade.metadata: First chunk carries a text metadata header naming the model component, sum16 and a 20-byte resource ID; remaining chunks carry the image.
firmware_upgrade.observed_result: Device information changed from V2.9.1#V18 before transfer to V2.9.1#V24 after disconnect/reconnect.
firmware_upgrade.rule: Do not use the ordinary image uploader as DFU and do not replay the captured type-4 stream. No wrong-image or interrupted-update recovery is established.

playback.note: Model/index combinations are app playback controls. Keep exact device lists and do not infer sensor events from short type-6 tag-0x36 notifications.

ids_pro.order: Preserve the exact list and order; the app displays each ID plus one

index.note: Raw app playback position; its numbering semantics are not established

program_upload.example_note: Synthetic 48x16 program-0 header and item declarations, sequences 1 and 2; no user media or unit identifier. Reproduce both with scripts/test_loypro_led_display.py.

media_chunks.item_prefix: Every chunk repeats save flag 09 01 01 and the graphic item's zero-based program (0c), region (0d) and item (0e) values before its chunk metadata and media

synthetic_vector.note: Framing-only vector with three invented media bytes, not a complete renderable image

resource_id.important: Hash original GIF/input bytes, not converted YSTP01. Captured cloud resources may use unrelated keys or zero timestamps; keys are identifiers, not secrets.
resource_id.input_description: JSON description of the program, or concatenated space-separated hexadecimal of the original input byte buffers
resource_id.local_generation: (decimal (wire_program_index + 1) + '0000000') truncated to 8 characters, followed by lowercase MD5 hex of the input description; decode the 40 ASCII hex characters to 20 bytes
resource_id.program_number_base: The prefix uses the one-based app/UI program number: wire_program_index + 1, distinct from the zero-based TLV fields

synthetic_vector.note: Synthetic three-byte hash input; the resource ID is 20 decoded bytes, not 40 ASCII bytes

sequence: Send a program header containing replacement, save, program, play configuration, region and geometry TLVs.
Send media chunks in ascending zero-based index order using media_chunks.tag_order; captured maximum logical chunk size is 960 bytes.
Wait for ordinary response 0x82 with the matching sequence and status 00 after every type-2 packet; all 84 in the capture answered.
Finalize with tag 0x35 and require its ACK. Deduplicate retransmissions by program/item/chunk index.
program_upload.storage_effect: The program header replaces the selected zero-based stored program. It is not a readiness probe.

tags.meaning: Delete/replace zero-based program ID in the program header
Zero-based item ID within the region
Item playback/media declaration; captured graphic items end in type 0x0a
Chunk metadata: total count LE16, zero-based index LE16, maximum chunk bytes LE16, then 00
Media bytes; raw GIF stays GIF, non-GIF graphics use the separate YSTP01 encoder
Animation/effect parameters; captured 01 0d 03 is an example, not a universal default
Region x, y, width, height as four LE16 values followed by background byte
Resource declaration/finalization: zero-based program byte, 20-byte key, u32 LE timestamp
Playback model/index/program list, not an accelerometer report

ystp01.boundary: Text uploads are rendered image pages, not a simple string command. Delay units, text rasterization and other YSTP depths/variants are not established. Synthetic vectors contain only primary colors and a grayscale palette, not captured user media.
ystp01.coverage: Two single-page 24-bit images and three colored text sequences with final blank pages; both 24-bit and 8-bit palettized pages were decoded.

delay.scaling: Raw device value; time scaling is not established

page_layout.pages: Concatenated in order with no per-page header; geometry, depth and palette come from the shared header
page_layout.palette_indices: Pack each index at its little-endian bit offset within the row; least-significant bit first
page_layout.rgb888: Three bytes per pixel in R,G,B order
page_layout.row_padding: Each row starts on a byte boundary; emit zero in unused high bits. Captured widths are byte-aligned, so device padding requirements are unknown.
page_layout.total_length_formula: 15 + palette_bytes + page_count * height * row_stride_bytes, where palette_bytes is 3 * (1 << bits_per_pixel) for depths <= 8 and zero for 24-bit

palette.note: A 24-bit stream has no palette. Palettized pages share this one palette. Lower depths are not established.

read_only_identification.notes: Twenty-byte dev_info_all query with example sequence 1. Subscribe to FFF1 first and use FFF2 without response. A real client increments sequence. Device-information TLV 0x0a carries identity/model/version/capabilities; panel TLV 0x1b carries a leading panel-data-type byte then little-endian width/height. Power TLV 0x04 reports type 1 and brightness TLV 0x06 fixed value 15. Stop if no valid reply arrives.

observed_reply.note: The MTU token is a firmware capability, not a negotiated-MTU measurement. Unit-specific identity and CID values are omitted.

tlv_length_encoding.extended_16: 82 LL LH: little-endian u16 length (256 and above)

next_read_only_queries.note: Only after fresh family identification; stop on an invalid reply. No binding or display writes.

vehicle_linkage.notes: These are app-assignable display program IDs, not demonstrated motion gestures. The separate type-2 binding operation was not attempted. Firmware contains an MSA311 driver but no numeric sensor stream was captured.

remaining_unknowns: Visible rendering from a new third-party upload and compatibility with other GIF sizes, frame counts, geometries, YSTP variants and program slots.
Vehicle-linkage mappings, sensor values, actual brake/remote event sources and any accelerometer scaling or motion-trigger map.
Factory reset, password configuration, optional maintenance services in other firmware states, and whether intermittent advertising is policy, power state or another central.
Wrong-image/interrupted firmware-update recovery and compatibility with any image other than the captured exact-model V24 upgrade.

characteristics.name: Display notifications
characteristics.notes: AA55 responses and playback notifications. Reassemble by declared AA55 length; an ATT fragment is not a new command.

get_device_info.description: Request device, panel, power and brightness information using the confirmed AA55 dev_info_all query in protocol_details.read_only_identification.

characteristics.name: Display writes
characteristics.notes: Use response=False. The capture negotiated MTU 512/517 and host ATT values were at most 509 bytes. Logical 960-byte media chunks are TLVs inside AA55 packets, not individual ATT writes; reassemble first.

services.name: LOY display service
services.notes: FFF0 appeared in the live session and capture. Other services may exist in other firmware states; FFF0 is shared and must not identify by itself.
